correctness.rationale: The formula is correct. The centered-uniform moment points satisfy v_m=m(m+1)/3 and d_m=m(m+1)/(2m+1)=3v_m/sqrt(12v_m+1). The latter curve is strictly concave, so Jensen over the discrete-uniform mixture gives the adjacent-chord upper envelope and its equality cases. U_0/U_R mixtures at fixed variance make MAD tend to zero, and convex mixing fills every intermediate value. The phase correction follows from the exact closed cell formula.

originality.rationale: Originality fails under the implication standard for the same structural reason. The known discrete-uniform mixture representation turns fixed-variance MAD into the convex hull of (v_m,d_m), and the elementary identity d_m=3v_m/sqrt(12v_m+1) is a strictly concave curve. Jensen/adjacent-chord interpolation therefore gives the exact upper envelope directly; mixing U_0 with remote uniforms gives the zero infimum.
